pairs.registryProposal: The standard defines when to score a grounded answer but not when a human-in-the-loop draft (generated from retrieved passages and edited before it is saved) is exempt. twin_simulate_answer pulls KB chunks into a grounding block and is never scored. A 'When not to use it' line covering human-reviewed drafts would make that boundary explicit, so seats stop disagreeing on n/a versus deviation.
